assumptions: Interpolation grid uses 25 µs intervals for ESC PWM between 1100 and 1900 µs.
Interpolation grid uses 2.0 V intervals for supply voltage between 10.0 and 20.0 V.
Values in deadband (1475 to 1525 µs) are fixed to quiescent levels (0.05 A current draw).
Bollard thrust and current values are symmetric between clockwise and counter-clockwise rotations, scaled down by 0.92 for reverse propulsion to match typical propeller geometry characteristics.
Efficiency is calculated as Bollard thrust (gf) / Electric Power (W).
